name: Ningen Konchuu ~Nozoki~
source:
When the guy was a child, he killed a lot of insects, about 100 a day. Now, as their revenge, he got turned into insects and has to live as a mantis, bee, spider and beetle. Will he ever be able to return to human form? He will never view insects the same way again.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公小时候杀死过无数昆虫，每天大约要杀100只。如今，昆虫前来复仇，把他变成同类，迫使他先后以螳螂、蜜蜂、蜘蛛和甲虫的身份生活。他还能恢复人形吗？从此以后，他再也无法以同样的眼光看待昆虫。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
